Theorem
[Existence and uniqueness of Dirichlet heat kernel] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0311 1. ch24:24.30\group Dirichlet Heat Kernels

Let $(\mathcal M^n,g)$ be compact with nonempty smooth boundary. There is a unique nonnegative Dirichlet heat kernel $H_D$, smooth in the interior, vanishing on the boundary, and converging to $\delta _y$ as $t\searrow 0$. It has the eigenfunction expansion \[ H_D(x,y,t)=\sum _{k=1}^\infty e^{-\lambda _kt}\varphi _k(x)\varphi _k(y). \]
